description: Every combination of control path, remote access, open or closed access and platform (children on the phones and a child's watch): who holds a Home Assistant key and which fields client_config carries. Hub only gives a key only with remote access; tvos, android_tv, watchos and wearos never run without a key (hub is checked there); a watch holds its key only while its phone's rule watch is on and gets its token only sealed; a closed access sends no token.
